proposed_widenings.name: subclass_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's entire mechanic is a permanent character-progression choice made at level-up: the player selects a subclass archetype, and that archetype grants features for the rest of the character's career. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family covers this — the only family is 'activation', which requires activationCost, resource (UseCountResource), resetCadence, and a ClassFeatureEffect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp). None of those fields exist for a subclass-choice gate. A new family (e.g. 'subclass_choice') is needed that records the class, the level at which the choice is made, and (optionally) a reference to the available archetypes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Warlock subclass of your choice. The Fiend Patron subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warlock levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Warlock level or lower.

notes: This is a class-wide pattern — every class has an identical 'XYZ Subclass' feature at level 3 (barbarian, bard, cleric, druid, fighter, monk, paladin, ranger, rogue, sorcerer, warlock, wizard). All instances will require the same widening. The mechanic is character-progression state, not a combat-engine activation. It has no activation cost, no quota, no rest reset, and no GrantExtraActionEffect or HealHpEffect. Encoding it under 'activation' with any effect would produce a false trace.
